items.title: U.S. Government Seizes Online Marketplaces Used to Sell Fraudulent Identity Documents to Cybercriminals
items.description: The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of New Mexico announced Thursday that federal authorities have executed a court-authorized seizure of two domain names and one affiliated blog associated with VerifTools, an online marketplace peddling counterfeit driver’s licenses, passports, and other state- and country-issued identity documents. Operating under the banner of VerifTools since 2020,…
